header.one_line: Assam plains to the Tawang valley in Arunachal Pradesh, over or under Sela Pass

rules.title: Arunachal Pradesh: Inner Line Permit for Indian citizens
rules.detail: Applied for online. The tourist permit allows a stay of up to 14 days. The official page lists 300 rupees up to three days and 500 rupees up to 14.
rules.applies_to: Indian citizens from outside Arunachal Pradesh

source.title: Tourist electronic Inner Line Permit: application page

history.change: New online permit portal launched across the state.

source.title: Arunachal Pradesh electronic Inner Line Permit portal

rules.title: Arunachal Pradesh: permit counters outside the portal
rules.detail: A Tawang advisory names issuing offices at Delhi, Kolkata, Guwahati, Tezpur and Bhalukpong. West Kameng district also issues it at the Deputy Commissioner's office in Bomdila.
rules.applies_to: Indian citizens from outside Arunachal Pradesh

source.title: Advisory, Office of the District Tourism Officer, Tawang

rules.title: Bum La: separate pass from the Tawang district administration
rules.detail: Apply on the district's portal or at the Deputy Commissioner's office. An order of 8 September 2026 says passes issued by anyone else are not legal.
rules.applies_to: All visitors; outsiders must already hold an Inner Line Permit

source.title: Order regarding issuance of Bumla Pass exclusively through authorized channels

history.change: Order that Bum La passes come only from the district administration, through its portal or office.

source.title: Order regarding issuance of Bumla Pass exclusively through authorized channels

rules.title: Bum La: enter by 10:30, leave by 14:00
rules.detail: The district portal gives an entry window of 7:00 to 10:30 in the morning and requires visitors to be out by 14:00 the same day.

source.title: Bumla Pass tourist permit portal

rules.title: Bum La: portal is silent on motorcycles
rules.detail: The district portal allows private vehicles and says commercial taxis must be registered in Tawang. It does not mention motorcycles. Several blogs say a local taxi is compulsory.

source.title: Bumla Pass tourist permit portal

rules.title: Bum La: visitor fee of 50 rupees
rules.detail: Charged per person aged 12 and above who is not from an Arunachal Pradesh Scheduled Tribe, after the pass is approved.

source.title: Bumla Pass tourist permit portal

rules.title: Tawang: one day of acclimatisation before high areas
rules.detail: The district tourism office's advisory of 27 August 2026 tells visitors to acclimatise for at least a day after arrival before Sela Pass, Bum La and the high lakes.

source.title: Advisory, Office of the District Tourism Officer, Tawang

history.change: Advisory issued; it also asks for non-skid chains on snow-covered roads.

source.title: Advisory, Office of the District Tourism Officer, Tawang

rules.title: Sela Pass: one-way traffic on alternate days in snow
rules.detail: After heavy snow the district administration has allowed Tawang-bound and West Kameng-bound traffic on alternate dates. This predates the tunnel; no later order was found.

source.title: Snowfall paralysis in Arunachal: Vehicles stranded on Balipara-Charduar-Tawang route

history.change: Advisory set alternate travel dates by direction from 5 to 12 February 2024.

source.title: Snowfall paralysis in Arunachal: Vehicles stranded on Balipara-Charduar-Tawang route

history.change: Sela Tunnel inaugurated, bypassing the pass.

source.title: Sela Tunnel

rules.title: Arunachal Pradesh: foreign citizens need a Protected Area Permit
rules.detail: The state permit portal is for Indian citizens only and sends foreign citizens to the Foreigners Regional Registration Office portal. Group size, validity and fee not found officially.
rules.set_by: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India

source.title: Tourist electronic Inner Line Permit: application page

rules.title: Tawang: areas closed to foreign citizens
rules.detail: A District Magistrate's order of 15 May 2026 bars foreign citizens, without written permission, beyond Pangateng Tso, Gorsam Stupa in Zemithang, kilometre 4 at Khrimu, and Murga Bridge near Jang.

source.title: Order, Office of the District Magistrate, Tawang: areas restricted for foreign visitors

history.change: Order issued after reports of foreign tourists moving beyond the permitted area near Pangateng Tso; hotels must verify permits.

source.title: Order, Office of the District Magistrate, Tawang: areas restricted for foreign visitors

season.note: Before the tunnel, snow shut or restricted Sela Pass for days at a time in winter; the Sela Tunnel has bypassed the pass since 9 March 2024.

history.note: About 30 vehicles were stranded by snow near Sela in early February; traffic then ran on alternate dates. The connected date is the tunnel's inauguration.

hazards.title: Landslides between Dirang and Sela
hazards.detail: In late August 2025 slides between Padma and Chepara and near Sapper Camp blocked about 120 metres of road and damaged two vehicles.

source.title: Massive landslide snaps Dirang-Tawang road link

hazards.title: Snow on the old road over Sela Pass
hazards.detail: In February 2024 snow between Jaswant Garh and Baisakhi stranded about 30 vehicles for three days. The district advisory asks for non-skid chains.

source.title: Snowfall paralysis in Arunachal: Vehicles stranded on Balipara-Charduar-Tawang route

hazards.title: Altitude at Sela and Bum La
hazards.detail: The district advisory warns people with heart or altitude problems against Sela Pass and Bum La, and tells visitors to stay off frozen lakes.

source.title: Advisory, Office of the District Tourism Officer, Tawang

hazards.title: Few fuel pumps between towns
hazards.detail: An operator guide advises filling up at Tezpur, Bomdila and Tawang, as pumps are rare in between.

gaps: No source found stating whether the old road over Sela Pass stays open to traffic now that the tunnel is in use.
No official statement found on whether motorcycles may go to Bum La; the district portal mentions private vehicles, taxis and government vehicles only.
Protected Area Permit group size, validity and fee for foreign citizens not found on an official page.
No official road status page found for the Balipara, Charduar, Tawang road; blockages surface through regional news.
No dated snow closures of Sela Pass found for years other than 2024.
The Sela Tunnel inauguration date comes from Wikipedia; no official release was opened.
Usual days and season come from a tour operator's guide, not an official source.
